title: A3 — High-performing storage
bodyMarkdown:
## High-performing storage

Exam task **3.1**. This lesson maps each knowledge and skill bullet from the supplied SAA-C03 guide.

### Knowledge

#### SAA-3.1-K01
Hybrid storage solutions to meet business requirements

**Tradeoffs:** Choose the simplest control that meets the requirement. Prefer managed services when operational overhead dominates. Use this lesson's citation link at the bottom before you lab. In a single-account lab, practice the smallest related resource then tear it down the same day. Multi-account or hybrid items may be design-only.

#### SAA-3.1-K02
Storage services with appropriate use cases (for example, Amazon S3, Amazon EFS, Amazon EBS)

**Tradeoffs:** Choose the simplest control that meets the requirement. Prefer managed services when operational overhead dominates. Use this lesson's citation link at the bottom before you lab. In a single-account lab, practice the smallest related resource then tear it down the same day. Multi-account or hybrid items may be design-only.

#### SAA-3.1-K03
Storage types with associated characteristics (for example, object, file, block)

**Tradeoffs:** Choose the simplest control that meets the requirement. Prefer managed services when operational overhead dominates. Use this lesson's citation link at the bottom before you lab. In a single-account lab, practice the smallest related resource then tear it down the same day. Multi-account or hybrid items may be design-only.

### Skills

#### SAA-3.1-S01
Determining storage services and configurations that meet performance demands

**Applied practice:** Complete the mapped guided/unguided lab or design exercise. Observable criteria are on that content item.

#### SAA-3.1-S02
Determining storage services that can scale to accommodate future needs

**Applied practice:** Complete the mapped guided/unguided lab or design exercise. Observable criteria are on that content item.

### Warnings

- Do not use the AWS root user for routine lab work.
- Stopping an instance is not teardown.
- $10 budget alerts warn; they do not stop spend.
